title: Anna: The Pleasure, the Torment
writer: Sauro Scavolini, Luciano Martino, Ernesto Gastaldi
actors: Edwige Fenech, Corrado Pani, Richard Conte
plot: A beautiful but poor young girl finds all the money and material goods she never had when she becomes the girlfriend of a crime boss, but soon learns that there is a price to be paid for that kind of life.
